// diagnostic

E0907

`mul` doesn't match the `Mul` contract

What

`mul` doesn't match the `Mul` contract

Why

A trait implementation must use the trait method's receiver, parameters, return type, and effects.

Fix

Write `fn mul(self, rhs: Money) Money`, matching the `Mul` declaration exactly, including `self`, types, labels, return type, and effects.

Worked example

Warning [L0102] (unused_parameter): Parameter `tree` is never used.
  --> tests/ui/hand_serde_bad_signature.jet:17:21
    |
 17 |     fn decode(self, tree: DataTree) Email ![FieldError] -> { return Ok(Email{addr: "x"}) }
    |                     ^^^^
 Why: An unused parameter often means the function contract or implementation is incomplete; Jet keeps this warning-only so prototypes stay unblocked.
 Fix: Use `tree`, rename it to `_tree` when it is intentionally unused, or remove it from the function contract.
